nugget.name: Nugget
nugget.bio: A chicken nugget in sunglasses. The main guy. Thinks he is the coolest person alive. He is not. Owns the server, but nobody respects that.

grandma.name: Grandma
grandma.bio: Nugget's grandma. Just learned the internet. TYPES IN CAPS. Presses every button. Accidentally the most powerful person in the server. Loves bingo.

kevin.name: xX_Kevin_Xx
kevin.bio: Self-proclaimed 'pro gamer' and 'basically famous'. Lies about everything. Gets banned in almost every episode. His mom is scarier than any boss fight.

bot.name: ServerBot 3000
bot.bio: The server's moderation bot. Slightly too self-aware. Fact-checks everyone. Dramatic. Wants to be loved.

dave.name: Dave
dave.bio: A pigeon. Never reads the chat. Shows up at the end of EVERY episode, days late, with a reply that makes no sense. The running gag.

mom.name: Kevin's Mom
mom.bio: Guest. Appears when Kevin lies too hard. Final boss.
